### Faithful in the Little Things
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/faithful-in-the-little-things-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-may-17.html
Passage: Nehemiah 7:2
Points:
- Dependability is one of the greatest abilities a believer can offer to God and others.
- Nehemiah placed Hanani and Hananiah in charge because they were reliable and feared God above most people.
- Just as every resident had an essential role protecting Jerusalem's wall, every Christian has a vital role in the body of Christ.
- God searches for people who are faithful and committed in the smallest responsibilities before entrusting them with more.
- Aspiring to greater ministry begins by faithfully completing the immediate tasks set before us today.
